0.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_000
0.description: Gaheel Ja not see any other Mamool Ja here. Why is this?

4.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_A1_000_003
4.description: Ask about the blue magic spellbook.

7.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_010
7.description: Totems hold aether of beasts from across Indigo Deep. They teach you blue magic without risk of being eaten!

8.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_015
8.description: Gaheel Ja is sorry, but <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> not ready for totems.

9.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_020
9.description: Blue magic discovered by Whalaqee. They live far from here, across Indigo Deep.

10.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_021
10.description: Whalaqee know many things, and see into souls of beasts.

11.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_022
11.description: When creature attacks, Whalaqee look into eyes and understand how it control aether. This secret of blue magic.

12.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_023
12.description: Martyn learned this from Whalaqee. Now he teach Eorzeans like you.

13.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_024
13.description: Remember─color blue very important. Whalaqee love blue things. Blue sky, blue sea, blue canyon. Even clothes blue. That is why it called blue magic.

14.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_025
14.description: Deep like ocean, endless like sky, blue magic is. No one, not even Whalaqee, understand all its mysteries.

15.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_030
15.description: Martyn write spellbook to help novices like you. It tell where to learn blue magic.

16.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_031
16.description: Why some names of creatures missing from book, you say? Like Whalaqee, Martyn spends much time in forests, deserts, plains, and fight many beasts. This part of training, he says. Strong mage casts strong spells. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> must become strong, too.

17.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_032
17.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> should not complain─this book very rare! Not many copies out there, so try not to lose it.

18.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_040
18.description: Latool Ja and Gaheel Ja know some blue magic too. We from Boonewa tribe, best spellcasters of all Mamool Ja. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> make us angry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> be sorry! Ha ha! Gaheel Ja only joking.

19.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_050
19.description: Why Martyn say nothing about Whalaqee disease? Why he do everything alone? Most times, Gaheel Ja think Martyn very clever, but this time Martyn very stupid! Very stupid indeed!

20.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_060
20.description: Azulmagia─I mean Whastrach─is best blue mage in Eorzea, even better than Martyn. Whastrach very talented spellcaster, so why he become “busyness man” instead? Gaheel Ja think he make bad choice.

21.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_070
21.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> beat Whastrach! Now <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> strongest blue mage! Maybe Martyn should be your apprentice now.

22.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_080
22.description: Martyn find many new spells. Now they written in your book. But reading book not enough. You must learn them for yourself!

23.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_090
23.description: Can Martyn beat Siegfried? Gaheel Ja not know, but this good chance to promote the guild!

24.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_100
24.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> very strong, but Siegfried not hesitate to use dirty tricks. Be very careful!

25.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_110
25.description: Gaheel Ja happy you defeat Siegfried! Maybe Celestium become more popular than Coliseum now, yes?

26.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_200
26.description: Martyn write more blue magic in your spellbook. It is gift of other brave adventurers who join Blue Mages' Guild, so if you are brave, you can learn these new spells too.

27.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_210
27.description: Mimic man Gogo study Celestium creatures, just like Martyn said he would. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> already champion of Masked Carnivale, so maybe those tricks not work on you, yes?

28.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_220
28.description: You made Gogo go bye-bye! See? Gaheel Ja just as smart with words as Latool Ja!

29.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_300
29.description: Martyn write more blue magic in your spellbook. He say it is gift from adventurers who travel to far away lands. Maybe someday, you will see these lands too.

30.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_310
30.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> will finally challenge Martyn? That will be interesting battle. Very, very interesting.

31.name: TEXT_CTSETCAOZGAHEELJA_00565_GAHEELJA_000_320
31.description: Gaheel Ja impressed you defeat Martyn! Gaheel Ja think you maybe stronger than Martyn, but that is secret between us, yes?
